decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1. The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 19th November 2002, the demolition of existing side/rear extension and erection of side/rear extension with a maximum height of 2.94m, maximum width of 1.8m and a maximum length 7.1m, was lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country 1990 for the following reason:
The proposed side/rear extension falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

2. The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 19th November 2002, the erection of a roof extension with a maximum height of 2.29m, maximum width of 4.38m and a maximum length of 8.85m, was lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The proposed roof extension falls within Section 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for demolition of existing side/rear extension and erection of side/rear extension and roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
